Subject: Next steps: schedule a 60–90m technical deep dive (TDX) and align agenda

Hi Tom — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

Summary (1-line)
- Aper Medical is evaluating inference runtimes for low-latency triage workflows; priority is predictable p95 < 250ms for embeddings-based search and auditability for logs.

Immediate next steps
1) Lock a 60–90 minute technical deep dive (TDX) with your ML/infra leads + our model/serving engineers. We want to cover architecture, data flows, and a short runthrough of a sample request pattern.
2) Share concise prep materials so your team can prioritize questions. See attached TDX-Prep-Checklist.pdf and a proposed agenda.

Proposed windows (your timezone, PST):
- Wed 28 Jul, 09:30–11:00
- Thu 29 Jul, 13:00–14:30
- Fri 30 Jul, 08:00–09:30

Please reply with preferred slot(s) and who from your engineering/security teams will attend. If none of the windows work, tell us two options and we’ll try to accommodate.

Agenda draft (high level)
- 5m introductions & success criteria
- 15m current infra + data handling / security constraints (Aper team)
- 25m Redwood runtime architecture & latency/cost levers
- 20m concrete runthrough: sample payloads, KV cache, batching implications
- 15m open Q&A + next steps / mutual action plan

Attachments: [Attachment: TDX-Prep-Checklist.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: 90min-Proposed-Agenda.md (text)]

Thanks — happy to loop in Ben (serving lead) for any infra-specific prep.

— Priya
